purpose: Secondary multi-window and paragraph diagnostic, defined after the initial 80-word aggregate became available. It cannot upgrade the original confirmatory inference or establish institutional generalization.
cases: Eight new families per language, three 256-word documents per family at exactly 25%, 50%, 75% machine words. Each file contains four free-text blocks of exactly 64 product words. A family contains four distinct human donors and four distinct generated donors (four source-matched HSS pairs in English). Fixed cyclic layout across families. Truncate each natural document once at word 64 without rewriting. An internally mixed new sample is excluded if its layout or labels do not validate. Stop at available complete families; report achieved size.
independence: Recreate the frozen original deterministic selection to recover its actual source/learner/paper groups. Remove every selected earlier-pool parent or learner from this tail before selection. Also reject exact duplicates and 16-word anchor overlap with earlier score-frozen inputs and the 14 locked development and historical panels. No selection on earlier predictions or per-source model error.
metrics: Use the already frozen HL3, CN8, CE8, plus the frozen neural pair if time permits, without fitting or any threshold change. Score absolute mixture percentage error only for estimators that actually produce a proportion. Compare displayed word highlights and actual plot-gold at token IoU, recall, precision, and document-cluster CIs. Separately calculate binary paragraph identification by >=50% highlighted words in that true paragraph. A production *% value exposes no visible spans. No institution-specific gate inferred from these diagnostic mixtures.
